# `tiktok_musically` — data-pipeline integration contract

Package `com.zhiliaoapp.musically`, version 24.2.0 (`2022402000`), APK sha256
`3a488bed7ae1b2da18a947161a94a312ae64ad01137339774d37d5847909f2f9`.
Native binaries `libeffect.so` (`dad4778a…e76c35`) and `libttvesdk.so`
(`e38abe25…a6ce74`) and all three model bundles are **byte-identical to the `trill`
variant**, so every address below applies to both.

Evidence files are relative to this directory. Frame interface details:
`evidence/video_interface.md`; per-frame call sites:
`evidence/vesdk_drawframe_callsites.txt`; strings:
`evidence/libeffect_face_video_strings.txt`.

## 1. Data sources / triggers

| # | trigger | exact location | confidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Camera preview / recorded clip / imported media rendered by VESDK | `libttvesdk.so` render function tagged by its own logs `DrawFrame:LoadResource` @0x5cb5e5, `DrawFrame:bef_effect_algorithm` @0x5cb62f, `[%d] bef_effect_process_texture >>>` @0x5cb6b4; frame loop 0x1cf4f0–0x1cfa60 | confirmed |
| 2 | Effect handle / resource finder / sticker (effect) load | `Java_com_bef_effectsdk_BEFEffectNative_nativeCreateHandle` @0x2ea99c, `nativeInitResourceFinder` @0x2eaa10, `nativeSetStickerPath` @0x2eab8c, `bef_effect_create_handle` @0x304a44; `…ModelnamesAssigner_nativeSetAssignedModelNames` @0x2ed484 | confirmed |
| 3 | Face-detection task activation | string `FaceDetectTaskTT.cpp` @0xd02a5c, class symbol `N3BEF16FaceDetectTaskTTE` @0xdc6877; AB gate `enable_fastmode_faceDetect240` @0xd64cbf + `bef_effect_use_TT_facedetect` @0x100f7 | strings confirmed, AB semantics inferred |
| 4 | Face-attribute task activation | `N3BEF18FaceAttributesTaskE` @0xdde608, `N3BEF23FaceAttributesAlgorithmE` @0xdde524, `…registerAlgorithm…` @0xdde544 | confirmed (symbols) |
| 5 | Model assets made available to the SDK | `com.bef.effectsdk.ModelsList.<clinit>` (classes2) lists the three `assets/model/…` paths; `com.bef.effectsdk.EffectSDKUtils` copies them to the app model dir | confirmed (report §2) |

Lifecycle: handle created once per VESDK session; per frame the render loop calls
`bef_effect_set_width_height` + a texture entry point; teardown via
`nativeDestroyHandle` @0x2ea9f8.

Java entry `BEFEffectNative.processFrame(long,int,int,int,int,double)` exists
(`sources/video/com.bef.effectsdk.BEFEffectNative.java:21,108`) but **no class in the APK
calls it** (`dex_find.py --regex processFrame` → declaration only, also in trill).
The app's frames therefore enter through `libttvesdk.so`, which links `libeffect.so`
directly (`readelf -d`: `NEEDED libeffect.so`) — confirmed.

## 2. Transport and format

| item | value | evidence | confidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| video payload | GL texture, **GL_TEXTURE_2D / RGBA8888 / UNSIGNED_BYTE** | `glTexImage2D(target=0xde1, internalformat=0x1908, format=0x1908, type=0x1401)` in `libttvesdk.so` 0x4b7314–0x4b7330 (thunk 0x55a760 → PLT 0x19fca0 → GOT `0x8c2d10`=`glTexImage2D`) | confirmed |
| texture id | int, first field of the per-input frame descriptor (`+0x00`, stride `0x48`) | `libttvesdk.so` 0x1cf944 `ldr w1,[x23]` | confirmed |
| width / height | ints at `+0x14` / `+0x18` of the same descriptor; on the JNI path they are Java args 4 and 5 | 0x1cf540 `ldp w1,w2,[x23,#0x14]`; `native/libeffect_musically_nativeProcessFrame.s` (0x2eac74/0x2eac80) | confirmed |
| timestamp | `double`, descriptor `+0x20`; JNI arg 6 | `ldr d0,[x23,#0x20]` @0x1cf554; JNI `d0` in 0x2eac84 | confirmed as double; **clock origin unknown** (frame PTS seconds assumed) |
| rotation | separate setter, degrees int | `nativeSetFrameOrientation` @0x2ead50 → `bef_effect_set_frame_device_orientation`; `nativeSetOrientation` @0x2ead44 → `bef_effect_set_orientation` | confirmed; value encoding (0/90/180/270) inferred |
| camera facing | separate setter, boolean, inverted on the way down | `nativeSetCameraPosition` @0x2ead0c → `bef_effect_set_camera_device_position(handle, !z)` (`tst w19,#0xff; cset w1,eq`) | confirmed |
| CPU fallback path | decoded frame uploaded to a `GL_TEXTURE_2D` then handed to `bef_effect_process_texture` | `libttvesdk.so` 0x4b72f0–0x4b7350 | confirmed |
| YUV / GRAY | rejected by every DNN task | `"FaceDetectTaskTT: Not support yuv/ gray!"` @0xd02ab1/0xd02adf, `"FaceAttributesTask: …"`, `"ExpressionDetectTask: …"` @0xd25120 | confirmed |
| thread | GL/render thread of the VESDK filter chain (the same thread that issues `glTexImage2D`) | call sites in one function; no worker thread hand-off observed | inferred |
| drop / skip policy | per-frame; SDK has `skipFrame`/`skipFrameAll`/fps counters | report §3 strings | inferred |

JNI argument layout (resolved, was `unknown` in the trill report):

```
processFrame(handle, texId, arg2, width, height, timestamp)
  -> bef_effect_set_width_height(handle, width, height)
  -> bef_effect_process_texture(handle, texId, arg2, timestamp)   # arg2 forwarded, unread by the wrapper
```

`bef_effect_process_texture` @0x3097f0 is a thunk adding `loadingTimeout = 0` and calling
`bef_effect_process_texture_with_loading_timeout`. `arg2` semantics remain **unknown**
(it is neither read in 0x3097f8–0x3098bc nor named by any string).

## 3. Preprocessing

| step | implementation | status |
|---|---|---|
| frame → detector input | texture sampled/cropped inside `BEF::FaceDetectTaskTT`; the task refuses YUV/GRAY, so the crop is taken from the GL texture | confirmed (task rejects non-texture; texture is the only input) |
| resize target | `base120` / `base120det` record names suggest 120×120; fast mode has `faceDetect240`/`280` variants (`enable_fastmode_faceDetect240` @0xd64cbf) | inferred |
| normalisation constants | the `mean` record (1905 float32 monotone pairs) is anchor/prior geometry, not image means (report §4.1) | confirmed negative; true scale/bias unknown |
| face-attribute crop | aligned face crop, size unknown. The `bgr448` assertion claimed in report §6 is **not present** in this `libeffect.so` (`grep 'bgr448|448'` → no hit); only `image format only support RGBA8888 or GRAY8` @0xca2276 exists | unknown |
| Java-side preprocessing | none — JNI passes handle + ints + double only | confirmed |
| whether the ops match the model contract | cannot be checked: the per-record payload descriptor schema is still unparsed (report §5) | unknown |

## 4. Model invocation

| item | value | confidence |
|---|---|---|
| runtime | ByteNN "espresso" (`espresso::Thrustor::CreateNet/SetInput/Inference/Extract/SkipLayer/DefaultInSize`) imported from `libbytenn.so`; `libeffect.so` never parses BM containers itself | confirmed (import table, report §5) |
| model files | `assets/model/ttfacemodel/tt_face_v10.0.model` (905 491 B, `175210db…`), `…/tt_face_extra_v13.0.model` (573 858 B, `d0f4e9f9…`), `assets/model/ttfaceattrmodel/tt_face_attribute_age_v1.1.model` (203 028 B, `8efeb7f2…`) | confirmed |
| sub-model records | `tt_face_v10.0`: detect, base120, base120det, pout, eyecls, partface, image, slowimage, mean; `tt_face_extra_v13.0`: iris, extra; `tt_face_attribute_age_v1.1`: agenet | confirmed (report §4) |
| model path source | asset paths from `ModelsList` → `EffectSDKUtils` copy → SDK resource finder | confirmed |
| tensor shapes / dtypes | **unknown** — descriptor block unparsed; `Tensor` supports NCHW/NHWC × Float/Fp16/Int8 (generic ByteNN API, not necessarily these bundles) | unknown |
| binding of the preprocessed buffer | espresso `SetInput(name, ptr, w, h, c)` with a raw buffer; textures are sampled inside the effect SDK before that call | inferred |
| batching / threads | one frame at a time; no batching observed | inferred |
| cadence | once per rendered frame, subject to SDK skip/drop paths | inferred |
| generic ByteNN path (app ML SDK, not these models) | `com.ss.bytenn.API` → `libbytennwrapper.so` → `libbytenn.so` | confirmed (report §2) |

## 5. Output postprocessing

Face result structs are published through the SDK event system:
`BES::NtfEvent<algorithm_result_face_st>` @0xdbe58d and
`BES::NtfEvent<algorithm_result_face_attrs_st>` @0xdbe232; string keys
`algorithm_result_face_st` @0xca414b and `algorithm_result_face_attrs_st` @0xca40e9.
Delivery to Java is a parcel read by `VEFaceDetectInfo.readFromParcel()`
(`X.C34719DjF` wrapper) or a direct conversion from `com.ss.android.medialib.model.FaceDetectInfo`.

`VEFaceDetectInfo` / `X.C64698PZc` fields (all confirmed from `covert()`):
`Rect rect`, `float score`, `PointF[106] points`, `float[106] pointVisibility`,
`float yaw`, `float pitch`, `float roll`, `float eyeDistance`,
`int faceID`, `int action`, `int trackCount`, and ext info `X.C64697PZb`
(mask bits: 1 = eyes 22 pts each, 2 = eyebrows 13, 4 = lips 64, 8 = iris 20 each —
read in that order in `C64697PZb.LIZ()`).

`VEFaceAttributeInfo` / `VEFaceAttribute`: `age` first, then `boyProb, attractive,
happyScore, expType(int), expProbs(float[7]), realFaceProb, quality, arousal, valence,
sadScore, angryScore, surpriseScore, maskProb, wearHatProb, mustacheProb, lipstickProb,
wearGlassProb, wearSunglassProb, blurScore, illumination`. Only `age` (`agenet` record)
has a shipped model; the rest stay at 0.

Public getters: `bef_effect_get_face_detect_result` @0x30b794,
`bef_effect_get_face_attrs_detect_result` @0x2f2248,
`bef_effect_get_expression_detect_result` @0x30b974.

Decode details that remain **unknown**: NMS/thresholds (not visible in Java, not
recovered from native), coordinate transform back to source space (the mesh struct
carries `view_width`/`view_height`, strings @0xca8405/0xca8461, implying a view-space
transform exists), temporal smoothing (classical tracker is in the effect SDK and was
not decompiled).

## 6. Consumer / action

| consumer | evidence | confidence |
|---|---|---|
| effect graph nodes (face reshape / beauty / makeup / stickers) | `BEF::FaceReshapeFeature`, `assets/ttlive_FaceReshape_V2.zip`, `ttlive_reshape_composer.zip`, `ttlive_beauty_composer.zip` (report §3) | assets + symbols confirmed, dependency on the DNN inferred |
| Java face-info API | `VEFaceDetectInfo.covert(FaceDetectInfo)`; referenced from classes8.dex / classes10.dex (recompiled classes not identified — obfuscated) | confirmed that these dexes reference it; consumer class unknown |
| face-attribute events | `handleFaceAttributeEvent` @0xca4550, `handleFaceAgeEvent` @0xca453d, `handleFaceInfoEvent` @0xca4465, `handleFaceFivePartEvent` @0xca4439, `handleFaceBeautyScoreEvent` @0xca4522 | confirmed (strings) |
| preview surface / encoder | VESDK filter chain: `DrawFrame` → effect → `Frames`/`Filters` (`vesdk::pub::Filters::set_bef_effect` @0x2eb830) → output surface | inferred (the frame path terminates in the VESDK output stage; exact encoder node not traced) |

User-visible effect: landmarks/pose drive face reshaping and beauty; `age`/other
attribute scores drive age/beauty effects; results are not uploaded to the network from
the AI path (no network calls observed in this path).

## 7. Failure and fallback

| condition | behaviour | evidence | confidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| model missing / not copied | task logs `FaceDetectTaskTT: Error!!! No detector !!!!!` @0xd02a24 and returns no result; no fallback detector ships in the APK | strings | confirmed |
| result container missing | `Error!!! No result container !!!!!` @0xd02a71 | string | confirmed |
| empty frame | `Image data is null!` @0xd23801 | string | confirmed |
| CPU pixel format | `Not support yuv!` / `Not support gray!` @0xd02ab1/@0xd02adf — silently no result | strings | confirmed |
| null handle | `bef_effect_process_texture_with_loading_timeout` returns `-5`; missing config → `-6` (0x309894/0x30989c) | disasm | confirmed |
| AB flag off | `enable_fastmode_faceDetect240` not set (`AB value of {…} not exist` @0xd60eef) → non-fast path / TT detector disabled | strings | inferred |
| asset update | `EffectSDKUtils.needUpdate()` compares `AssetManager.open().available()` and re-copies | report §2 | confirmed |

## 8. Confidence and open questions

| claim | confidence | evidence | what would settle it |
|---|---|---|---|
| frame is a GL_TEXTURE_2D RGBA8888 texture | confirmed | libttvesdk 0x4b7314–0x4b7330 | done |
| width/height are Java args 4/5, timestamp is the double | confirmed | `native/libeffect_musically_nativeProcessFrame.s` | done |
| args 2/3 are forwarded to `bef_effect_process_texture` in order | confirmed | thunks 0xaf58d4 / 0xa9f91c | done |
| meaning of forwarded `arg2` | unknown | not read in 0x3097f8–0x3098bc | symbol-level debug of `bef_effect_process_texture_with_loading_timeout` or a matching public SDK header |
| the app path is libttvesdk → libeffect (not Java `processFrame`) | confirmed | dex scan + `NEEDED libeffect.so` | done |
| detector input is 120×120 | inferred | `base120` record name | payload descriptor parse |
| attribute crop size | unknown | no `448`/`bgr448` string in libeffect | descriptor parse or a runtime trace |
| 106-point layout / field order | confirmed | `X.C64698PZc`, `VEFaceDetectInfo.covert` | done |
| NMS / thresholds / smoothing | unknown | not present in Java; native tracker not decompiled | Ghidra on `BEF::FaceDetectTaskTT` methods |

## 9. Reimplementation mapping

| stage | JAX module | contract | status |
|---|---|---|---|
| container parse | `reimpl/model_container.py` (`ModelPackage.parse`) | real: returns per-record name / descriptor size / weight region for all 12 records | real code |
| detector | `reimpl/pipeline.py` `face_detector` | in `(1,120,120,3)` float32 (BGR, `(x-127.5)/128`), out `pout (1,30,30,1)`, `box (1,30,30,4)` | ARCHITECTURE_ONLY |
| landmark / eye refinement | `reimpl/pipeline.py` `extra_model` | in `(1,120,120,3)`, out `iris (1,30,30,2)`, `eyecls (1,2)`, `partface (1,30,30,5)` | ARCHITECTURE_ONLY |
| age attribute | `reimpl/pipeline.py` `age_model` | in `(1,448,448,3)`, out `(1,1)` | ARCHITECTURE_ONLY (448 is a guess; not corroborated) |
| video front-end | **not reimplemented** | would need: RGBA8 texture → RGB, crop by previous frame / tile, resize to the model input, NCHW float | out of scope of the current reimpl |

All four networks are placeholders; only the container reader and the decoded 1905
float32 `mean` values are real. A numerical reimplementation is blocked on the
per-record payload descriptor schema (report §5), which lives only in the stripped
`libeffect.so` smash-face loader. The video glue (texture handling, w/h, orientation,
camera facing, timestamp) is now fully documented and is not a blocker.

`bef_effect_process_texture` @0x3097f0 is a thunk adding `loadingTimeout = 0` and calling
`bef_effect_process_texture_with_loading_timeout`. `arg2` semantics remain **unknown**
(it is neither read in 0x3097f8–0x3098bc nor named by any string).

## 3. Preprocessing

| step | implementation | status |
|---|---|---|
| frame → detector input | texture sampled/cropped inside `BEF::FaceDetectTaskTT`; the task refuses YUV/GRAY, so the crop is taken from the GL texture | confirmed (task rejects non-texture; texture is the only input) |
| resize target | `base120` / `base120det` record names suggest 120×120; fast mode has `faceDetect240`/`280` variants (`enable_fastmode_faceDetect240` @0xd64cbf) | inferred |
| normalisation constants | the `mean` record (1905 float32 monotone pairs) is anchor/prior geometry, not image means (report §4.1) | confirmed negative; true scale/bias unknown |
| face-attribute crop | aligned face crop, size unknown. The `bgr448` assertion claimed in report §6 is **not present** in this `libeffect.so` (`grep 'bgr448|448'` → no hit); only `image format only support RGBA8888 or GRAY8` @0xca2276 exists | unknown |
| Java-side preprocessing | none — JNI passes handle + ints + double only | confirmed |
| whether the ops match the model contract | cannot be checked: the per-record payload descriptor schema is still unparsed (report §5) | unknown |

## 4. Model invocation

| item | value | confidence |
|---|---|---|
| runtime | ByteNN "espresso" (`espresso::Thrustor::CreateNet/SetInput/Inference/Extract/SkipLayer/DefaultInSize`) imported from `libbytenn.so`; `libeffect.so` never parses BM containers itself | confirmed (import table, report §5) |
| model files | `assets/model/ttfacemodel/tt_face_v10.0.model` (905 491 B, `175210db…`), `…/tt_face_extra_v13.0.model` (573 858 B, `d0f4e9f9…`), `assets/model/ttfaceattrmodel/tt_face_attribute_age_v1.1.model` (203 028 B, `8efeb7f2…`) | confirmed |
| sub-model records | `tt_face_v10.0`: detect, base120, base120det, pout, eyecls, partface, image, slowimage, mean; `tt_face_extra_v13.0`: iris, extra; `tt_face_attribute_age_v1.1`: agenet | confirmed (report §4) |
| model path source | asset paths from `ModelsList` → `EffectSDKUtils` copy → SDK resource finder | confirmed |
| tensor shapes / dtypes | **unknown** — descriptor block unparsed; `Tensor` supports NCHW/NHWC × Float/Fp16/Int8 (generic ByteNN API, not necessarily these bundles) | unknown |
| binding of the preprocessed buffer | espresso `SetInput(name, ptr, w, h, c)` with a raw buffer; textures are sampled inside the effect SDK before that call | inferred |
| batching / threads | one frame at a time; no batching observed | inferred |
| cadence | once per rendered frame, subject to SDK skip/drop paths | inferred |
| generic ByteNN path (app ML SDK, not these models) | `com.ss.bytenn.API` → `libbytennwrapper.so` → `libbytenn.so` | confirmed (report §2) |

## 5. Output postprocessing

Face result structs are published through the SDK event system:
`BES::NtfEvent<algorithm_result_face_st>` @0xdbe58d and
`BES::NtfEvent<algorithm_result_face_attrs_st>` @0xdbe232; string keys
`algorithm_result_face_st` @0xca414b and `algorithm_result_face_attrs_st` @0xca40e9.
Delivery to Java is a parcel read by `VEFaceDetectInfo.readFromParcel()`
(`X.C34719DjF` wrapper) or a direct conversion from `com.ss.android.medialib.model.FaceDetectInfo`.

`VEFaceDetectInfo` / `X.C64698PZc` fields (all confirmed from `covert()`):
`Rect rect`, `float score`, `PointF[106] points`, `float[106] pointVisibility`,
`float yaw`, `float pitch`, `float roll`, `float eyeDistance`,
`int faceID`, `int action`, `int trackCount`, and ext info `X.C64697PZb`
(mask bits: 1 = eyes 22 pts each, 2 = eyebrows 13, 4 = lips 64, 8 = iris 20 each —
read in that order in `C64697PZb.LIZ()`).

`VEFaceAttributeInfo` / `VEFaceAttribute`: `age` first, then `boyProb, attractive,
happyScore, expType(int), expProbs(float[7]), realFaceProb, quality, arousal, valence,
sadScore, angryScore, surpriseScore, maskProb, wearHatProb, mustacheProb, lipstickProb,
wearGlassProb, wearSunglassProb, blurScore, illumination`. Only `age` (`agenet` record)
has a shipped model; the rest stay at 0.

Public getters: `bef_effect_get_face_detect_result` @0x30b794,
`bef_effect_get_face_attrs_detect_result` @0x2f2248,
`bef_effect_get_expression_detect_result` @0x30b974.

Decode details that remain **unknown**: NMS/thresholds (not visible in Java, not
recovered from native), coordinate transform back to source space (the mesh struct
carries `view_width`/`view_height`, strings @0xca8405/0xca8461, implying a view-space
transform exists), temporal smoothing (classical tracker is in the effect SDK and was
not decompiled).

## 6. Consumer / action

| consumer | evidence | confidence |
|---|---|---|
| effect graph nodes (face reshape / beauty / makeup / stickers) | `BEF::FaceReshapeFeature`, `assets/ttlive_FaceReshape_V2.zip`, `ttlive_reshape_composer.zip`, `ttlive_beauty_composer.zip` (report §3) | assets + symbols confirmed, dependency on the DNN inferred |
| Java face-info API | `VEFaceDetectInfo.covert(FaceDetectInfo)`; referenced from classes8.dex / classes10.dex (recompiled classes not identified — obfuscated) | confirmed that these dexes reference it; consumer class unknown |
| face-attribute events | `handleFaceAttributeEvent` @0xca4550, `handleFaceAgeEvent` @0xca453d, `handleFaceInfoEvent` @0xca4465, `handleFaceFivePartEvent` @0xca4439, `handleFaceBeautyScoreEvent` @0xca4522 | confirmed (strings) |
| preview surface / encoder | VESDK filter chain: `DrawFrame` → effect → `Frames`/`Filters` (`vesdk::pub::Filters::set_bef_effect` @0x2eb830) → output surface | inferred (the frame path terminates in the VESDK output stage; exact encoder node not traced) |

User-visible effect: landmarks/pose drive face reshaping and beauty; `age`/other
attribute scores drive age/beauty effects; results are not uploaded to the network from
the AI path (no network calls observed in this path).

## 7. Failure and fallback

| condition | behaviour | evidence | confidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| model missing / not copied | task logs `FaceDetectTaskTT: Error!!! No detector !!!!!` @0xd02a24 and returns no result; no fallback detector ships in the APK | strings | confirmed |
| result container missing | `Error!!! No result container !!!!!` @0xd02a71 | string | confirmed |
| empty frame | `Image data is null!` @0xd23801 | string | confirmed |
| CPU pixel format | `Not support yuv!` / `Not support gray!` @0xd02ab1/@0xd02adf — silently no result | strings | confirmed |
| null handle | `bef_effect_process_texture_with_loading_timeout` returns `-5`; missing config → `-6` (0x309894/0x30989c) | disasm | confirmed |
| AB flag off | `enable_fastmode_faceDetect240` not set (`AB value of {…} not exist` @0xd60eef) → non-fast path / TT detector disabled | strings | inferred |
| asset update | `EffectSDKUtils.needUpdate()` compares `AssetManager.open().available()` and re-copies | report §2 | confirmed |

## 8. Confidence and open questions

| claim | confidence | evidence | what would settle it |
|---|---|---|---|
| frame is a GL_TEXTURE_2D RGBA8888 texture | confirmed | libttvesdk 0x4b7314–0x4b7330 | done |
| width/height are Java args 4/5, timestamp is the double | confirmed | `native/libeffect_musically_nativeProcessFrame.s` | done |
| args 2/3 are forwarded to `bef_effect_process_texture` in order | confirmed | thunks 0xaf58d4 / 0xa9f91c | done |
| meaning of forwarded `arg2` | unknown | not read in 0x3097f8–0x3098bc | symbol-level debug of `bef_effect_process_texture_with_loading_timeout` or a matching public SDK header |
| the app path is libttvesdk → libeffect (not Java `processFrame`) | confirmed | dex scan + `NEEDED libeffect.so` | done |
| detector input is 120×120 | inferred | `base120` record name | payload descriptor parse |
| attribute crop size | unknown | no `448`/`bgr448` string in libeffect | descriptor parse or a runtime trace |
| 106-point layout / field order | confirmed | `X.C64698PZc`, `VEFaceDetectInfo.covert` | done |
| NMS / thresholds / smoothing | unknown | not present in Java; native tracker not decompiled | Ghidra on `BEF::FaceDetectTaskTT` methods |

## 9. Reimplementation mapping

| stage | JAX module | contract | status |
|---|---|---|---|
| container parse | `reimpl/model_container.py` (`ModelPackage.parse`) | real: returns per-record name / descriptor size / weight region for all 12 records | real code |
| detector | `reimpl/pipeline.py` `face_detector` | in `(1,120,120,3)` float32 (BGR, `(x-127.5)/128`), out `pout (1,30,30,1)`, `box (1,30,30,4)` | ARCHITECTURE_ONLY |
| landmark / eye refinement | `reimpl/pipeline.py` `extra_model` | in `(1,120,120,3)`, out `iris (1,30,30,2)`, `eyecls (1,2)`, `partface (1,30,30,5)` | ARCHITECTURE_ONLY |
| age attribute | `reimpl/pipeline.py` `age_model` | in `(1,448,448,3)`, out `(1,1)` | ARCHITECTURE_ONLY (448 is a guess; not corroborated) |
| video front-end | **not reimplemented** | would need: RGBA8 texture → RGB, crop by previous frame / tile, resize to the model input, NCHW float | out of scope of the current reimpl |

All four networks are placeholders; only the container reader and the decoded 1905
float32 `mean` values are real. A numerical reimplementation is blocked on the
per-record payload descriptor schema (report §5), which lives only in the stripped
`libeffect.so` smash-face loader. The video glue (texture handling, w/h, orientation,
camera facing, timestamp) is now fully documented and is not a blocker.

# `tiktok_musically` — data-pipeline integration contract

Package `com.zhiliaoapp.musically`, version 24.2.0 (`2022402000`), APK sha256
`3a488bed7ae1b2da18a947161a94a312ae64ad01137339774d37d5847909f2f9`.
Native binaries `libeffect.so` (`dad4778a…e76c35`) and `libttvesdk.so`
(`e38abe25…a6ce74`) and all three model bundles are **byte-identical to the `trill`
variant**, so every address below applies to both.

Evidence files are relative to this directory. Frame interface details:
`evidence/video_interface.md`; per-frame call sites:
`evidence/vesdk_drawframe_callsites.txt`; strings:
`evidence/libeffect_face_video_strings.txt`.

## 1. Data sources / triggers

| # | trigger | exact location | confidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Camera preview / recorded clip / imported media rendered by VESDK | `libttvesdk.so` render function tagged by its own logs `DrawFrame:LoadResource` @0x5cb5e5, `DrawFrame:bef_effect_algorithm` @0x5cb62f, `[%d] bef_effect_process_texture >>>` @0x5cb6b4; frame loop 0x1cf4f0–0x1cfa60 | confirmed |
| 2 | Effect handle / resource finder / sticker (effect) load | `Java_com_bef_effectsdk_BEFEffectNative_nativeCreateHandle` @0x2ea99c, `nativeInitResourceFinder` @0x2eaa10, `nativeSetStickerPath` @0x2eab8c, `bef_effect_create_handle` @0x304a44; `…ModelnamesAssigner_nativeSetAssignedModelNames` @0x2ed484 | confirmed |
| 3 | Face-detection task activation | string `FaceDetectTaskTT.cpp` @0xd02a5c, class symbol `N3BEF16FaceDetectTaskTTE` @0xdc6877; AB gate `enable_fastmode_faceDetect240` @0xd64cbf + `bef_effect_use_TT_facedetect` @0x100f7 | strings confirmed, AB semantics inferred |
| 4 | Face-attribute task activation | `N3BEF18FaceAttributesTaskE` @0xdde608, `N3BEF23FaceAttributesAlgorithmE` @0xdde524, `…registerAlgorithm…` @0xdde544 | confirmed (symbols) |
| 5 | Model assets made available to the SDK | `com.bef.effectsdk.ModelsList.<clinit>` (classes2) lists the three `assets/model/…` paths; `com.bef.effectsdk.EffectSDKUtils` copies them to the app model dir | confirmed (report §2) |

Lifecycle: handle created once per VESDK session; per frame the render loop calls
`bef_effect_set_width_height` + a texture entry point; teardown via
`nativeDestroyHandle` @0x2ea9f8.

Java entry `BEFEffectNative.processFrame(long,int,int,int,int,double)` is called by
`com.ss.android.ugc.aweme.view.customView.NaviGLSurfaceView.onDrawFrame`
(`sources/video/NaviGLSurfaceView.java:233,245,265`), on the GL render thread. The
earlier "no class in the APK calls it" was a `dex_find --regex processFrame` artifact:
the call site is inside `onDrawFrame`, not a method named `processFrame`. The recorder
path is native `libttvesdk.so` → `libeffect.so` (`NEEDED`); the Navi preview path is the
confirmed Java caller.

## 2. Transport and format

| item | value | evidence | confidence |
|---|---|---|---|

# Android AI/DNN reverse-engineering workspace

Single working directory for the APK AI survey and the per-APK reverse-engineering
reports. Generated 2026-10-24. All target APKs were analysed statically; no APK or
mounted image was modified.

## Scope

- Source image: `/run/media/asdf/30620d0d-1e41-4d55-af08-b4de2fb9c517/xiaomi poco f4 system/`
- 515 APKs scanned for on-device model assets, NN runtimes, and AI API markers.
- 53 candidate targets recorded in `targets.json`.
- 15 final targets in `scope.json`: intersection of the Xiaomi/POCO/partner rows
  with "ships an on-device model/runtime".
- Google-made apps were excluded (GmsCore, Velvet, Dialer, Messages, Photos,
  Drive, LatinIME, Turbo, Phonesky, AndroidSystemIntelligence,
  PrivateComputeServices, AdServices, OnDevicePersonalization, FederatedCompute,
  Maps, Chrome, WebView, Gmail, Meet, Assistant, Speech, TalkBack, SwitchAccess).

## Quick start

```bash

# Start here: per-app data-pipeline index and corrections

# One report
cd reports/miui_securitycenter
cat report.md
cat PIPELINE.md
python "$HOME/re_workspace/venv312/bin/python" reimpl/model.py models/assets_model
```

## Layout

# Android AI/DNN reverse-engineering workspace

- 53 candidate targets recorded in `targets.json`.
- 15 final targets in `scope.json`: intersection of the Xiaomi/POCO/partner rows
  with "ships an on-device model/runtime".
- Google-made apps were excluded (GmsCore, Velvet, Dialer, Messages, Photos,
  Drive, LatinIME, Turbo, Phonesky, AndroidSystemIntelligence,
  PrivateComputeServices, AdServices, OnDevicePersonalization, FederatedCompute,
  Maps, Chrome, WebView, Gmail, Meet, Assistant, Speech, TalkBack, SwitchAccess).

```bash

## Layout

| Path | Contents |
|---|---|
| `PIPELINES.md` | Index of all 15 apps, data-pipeline counts, reimplementation status, key corrections |
| `pipelines_index.json` | Machine-readable form of the same index |
| `PIPELINE_TEMPLATE.md` | Canonical 9-section data-pipeline contract used by every report |
| `PLAYBOOK.md` | Per-target reverse-engineering workflow and output rules |
| `SCHEMA.json` | Findings schema (`features`, `models`, `reimplementation`, `unknowns`) |

| `shared/` | Shared notes and cross-report material |
| `work/` | Temporary tool test output |
| `*.s` at root | Ad-hoc disassembly fragments from cross-report investigations |

## Per-report contract

Every `reports/<slug>/` contains:

| Item | Description |
|---|---|
| `report.md` | Human analysis: identity, features, evidence, corrections, unknowns |
| `PIPELINE.md` | Data path: source/trigger → transport/format → preprocessing → model invocation → postprocessing → consumer → failure/fallback → confidence → reimplementation mapping |
| `findings.json` | Machine-readable features/models/unknowns plus `data_pipelines` |
| `sources/` | Targeted `jadx --single-class` output only (no full-APK decompilation) |
| `native/` | ELF facts, JNI signatures, disassembly, Ghidra pseudocode |
| `models/` | Extracted models/weights (size-capped) |
| `ir/` | Model IR: tensors, ops, shapes, weights tables |
| `reimpl/` | Runnable JAX reference implementation and `verify.txt` |
| `evidence/` | Command transcripts, hashes, xrefs, validators |

`PIPELINE.md` is the canonical data-flow contract. `findings.json.data_pipelines`
is the machine-readable companion; its key names vary slightly between reports
because each app exposes different data types.

| slug | app | AI subsystem | reimplementation |
|---|---|---|---|
| `miui_securitycenter` | MIUI Security | SMS spam/phishing cascade; new TFLite engine; delegated AI subtitles/UltraClear | verified |
| `miui_securitycoreadd` | Security Core Add | AI auto-brightness inference + on-device training | verified |
| `miui_mediaeditor` | Mi Media Editor | Face/body beauty, scene recognition, makeup, inpaint | verified |
| `miui_extraphoto` | ExtraPhoto | Document scan, relighting, dual-camera bokeh | runs_unverified |
| `miui_biometric` | Biometric face unlock | Enroll/auth, liveness, embedding, template match | architecture_only |
| `miui_paymentservice` | Payment Service | Card digit OCR (HOG + LIBSVM) | verified |

| `tiktok_musically` | TikTok (musically) | Face detect/landmark/age → video effects | architecture_only |
| `tiktok_trill` | TikTok (trill) | Face detect/landmark/age → video effects | architecture_only |

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Decoder for FaceUnity/MiMediaEditor `.bundle` containers.

Container layout (reversed from libCNamaSDK.so::CNamaSDK::BundleHelper::
DecryptObfuscatedPackage, vaddr 0x56fd68; see native/cnamasdk_bundle.c):

    0   4   magic  f3 5b 06 12
    4   8   header bytes;  XOR key k = byte[4] ^ byte[5] ^ byte[6]
    12  16  IV for the first 1024-byte block
    28  1040 ciphertext of the first 1056-byte block (16-byte prologue +
            1024 payload bytes that are inserted at output offset 0)
    1068..  remainder, copied verbatim
    tail    all of the output is then XOR-ed with the single byte k

The result is a normal ZIP archive (DEFLATE entries).  Entries whose data
starts below offset 1024 sit in the strongly encrypted prologue and cannot be
recovered without `BundleHelper::_obfuscation_key`; everything else decodes.

    python unbundle.py list   <file.bundle>
    python unbundle.py extract <file.bundle> <outdir>
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import os
import struct
import sys
import zlib

MAGIC = bytes.fromhex("f35b0612")
HDR = 1068          # 4 magic + 8 hdr + 16 iv + 1040 first-block ciphertext
PLAIN = 1024        # decrypted prefix length


def decrypt_prefix(data: bytes) -> bytes:
    """Return the 1024-byte plaintext prefix, or raise if it cannot be done."""
    raise NotImplementedError(
        "first 1024 bytes are encrypted with CNamaSDK::BundleHelper::DecryptObfuscatedPackageTFE "
        "(table cipher keyed by BundleHelper::_obfuscation_key) - key not present in the APK"
    )


def load_container(path: str) -> tuple[bytes, int, bytes]:
    d = open(path, "rb").read()
    if d[:4] != MAGIC:
        raise ValueError(f"{path}: bad magic {d[:4].hex()} (expected {MAGIC.hex()})")
    k = d[4] ^ d[5] ^ d[6]
    body = bytes(c ^ k for c in d[HDR:])
    return d, k, body


def zip_entries(d: bytes, k: int, body: bytes) -> list[dict]:
    eocd = body.rfind(b"PK\x05\x06")
    if eocd < 0:
        raise ValueError("no EOCD")
    disk, cdisk, n1, n2, cdsz, cdoff, clen = struct.unpack_from("<HHHHIIH", body, eocd + 4)
    cd = body[cdoff - PLAIN:cdoff - PLAIN + cdsz]
    out, i = [], 0
    while i < len(cd):
        if cd[i:i + 4] != b"PK\x01\x02":
            raise ValueError(f"bad central directory at {i}")
        (_, _, flags, meth, _, _, crc, csz, usz, nlen, elen, clen2,
         _, _, _, off) = struct.unpack_from("<HHHHHHIIIHHHHHII", cd, i + 4)
        name = cd[i + 46:i + 46 + nlen].decode("utf-8", "replace")
        out.append(dict(name=name, method=meth, flags=flags, crc=crc,
                        csize=csz, usize=usz, offset=off))
        i += 46 + nlen + elen + clen2
    for e in out:
        e["encrypted"] = e["offset"] < PLAIN
    return out


def read_entry(d: bytes, k: int, e: dict) -> bytes | None:
    """Return the decompressed entry, or None when it lies in the encrypted prefix."""
    start = e["offset"]
    if start < PLAIN:
        return None
    # local file header is 30 bytes + name + extra; find it after the prefix
    lh = start - PLAIN
    sig = bytes(b ^ k for b in b"PK\x03\x04")
    if d[HDR + lh:HDR + lh + 4] != sig:
        idx = d.find(sig, HDR + lh, HDR + lh + 256)
        if idx < 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{e['name']}: local header not found at {start}")
        lh = idx - HDR
    hdr = bytes(b ^ k for b in d[HDR + lh:HDR + lh + 30])
    nlen, elen = struct.unpack_from("<HH", hdr, 26)
    ds = HDR + lh + 30 + nlen + elen
    raw = bytes(c ^ k for c in d[ds:ds + e["csize"]])
    if e["method"] == 0:
        return raw
    if e["method"] == 8:
        return zlib.decompress(raw, -15)
    raise ValueError(f"unsupported method {e['method']}")


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("cmd", choices=["list", "extract"])
    ap.add_argument("bundle")
    ap.add_argument("outdir", nargs="?")
    a = ap.parse_args()

    d, k, body = load_container(a.bundle)
    entries = zip_entries(d, k, body)
    print(f"{os.path.basename(a.bundle)}: xor_key=0x{k:02x} "
          f"file={len(d)}B entries={len(entries)}")
    for e in entries:
        flag = " ENCRYPTED-PREFIX" if e["encrypted"] else ""
        print(f"  {e['name']:58s} method={e['method']} "
              f"csize={e['csize']:9d} usize={e['usize']:9d} "
              f"off={e['offset']:9d}{flag}")
    n_crc = n_bad = 0
    for e in entries:
        if e["encrypted"]:
            continue
        try:
            data = read_entry(d, k, e)
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"  ERROR {e['name']}: {exc}")
            n_bad += 1
            continue
        if zlib.crc32(data) & 0xFFFFFFFF != e["crc"]:
            print(f"  CRC-MISMATCH {e['name']}")
            n_bad += 1
        else:
            n_crc += 1
    print(f"  CRC32 verified entries: {n_crc} ok, {n_bad} bad "
          f"({sum(1 for e in entries if e['encrypted'])} skipped in encrypted prefix)")
    if a.cmd == "extract":
        assert a.outdir
        os.makedirs(a.outdir, exist_ok=True)
        for e in entries:
            data = read_entry(d, k, e)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Decoder for FaceUnity/MiMediaEditor `.bundle` containers.

Container layout (reversed from libCNamaSDK.so::CNamaSDK::BundleHelper::
DecryptObfuscatedPackage, vaddr 0x56fd68; see native/cnamasdk_bundle.c):

    0   4   magic  f3 5b 06 12
    4   8   header bytes;  XOR key k = byte[4] ^ byte[5] ^ byte[6]
    12  16  IV for the first 1024-byte block
    28  1040 ciphertext of the first 1056-byte block (16-byte prologue +
            1024 payload bytes that are inserted at output offset 0)
    1068..  remainder, copied verbatim
    tail    all of the output is then XOR-ed with the single byte k

The result is a normal ZIP archive (DEFLATE entries).  Entries whose data
starts below offset 1024 sit in the strongly encrypted prologue and cannot be
recovered without `BundleHelper::_obfuscation_key`; everything else decodes.

    python unbundle.py list   <file.bundle>
    python unbundle.py extract <file.bundle> <outdir>
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import os
import struct
import sys
import zlib

MAGIC = bytes.fromhex("f35b0612")
HDR = 1068          # 4 magic + 8 hdr + 16 iv + 1040 first-block ciphertext
PLAIN = 1024        # decrypted prefix length


def decrypt_prefix(data: bytes) -> bytes:
    """Return the 1024-byte plaintext prefix, or raise if it cannot be done."""
    raise NotImplementedError(
        "first 1024 bytes are encrypted with CNamaSDK::BundleHelper::DecryptObfuscatedPackageTFE "
        "(table cipher keyed by BundleHelper::_obfuscation_key) - key not present in the APK"
    )


def load_container(path: str) -> tuple[bytes, int, bytes]:
    d = open(path, "rb").read()
    if d[:4] != MAGIC:
        raise ValueError(f"{path}: bad magic {d[:4].hex()} (expected {MAGIC.hex()})")
    k = d[4] ^ d[5] ^ d[6]
    body = bytes(c ^ k for c in d[HDR:])
    return d, k, body


def zip_entries(d: bytes, k: int, body: bytes) -> list[dict]:
    eocd = body.rfind(b"PK\x05\x06")
    if eocd < 0:
        raise ValueError("no EOCD")
    disk, cdisk, n1, n2, cdsz, cdoff, clen = struct.unpack_from("<HHHHIIH", body, eocd + 4)
    cd = body[cdoff - PLAIN:cdoff - PLAIN + cdsz]
    out, i = [], 0
    while i < len(cd):
        if cd[i:i + 4] != b"PK\x01\x02":
            raise ValueError(f"bad central directory at {i}")
        (_, _, flags, meth, _, _, crc, csz, usz, nlen, elen, clen2,
         _, _, _, off) = struct.unpack_from("<HHHHHHIIIHHHHHII", cd, i + 4)
        name = cd[i + 46:i + 46 + nlen].decode("utf-8", "replace")
        out.append(dict(name=name, method=meth, flags=flags, crc=crc,
                        csize=csz, usize=usz, offset=off))
        i += 46 + nlen + elen + clen2
    for e in out:
        e["encrypted"] = e["offset"] < PLAIN
    return out


def read_entry(d: bytes, k: int, e: dict) -> bytes | None:
    """Return the decompressed entry, or None when it lies in the encrypted prefix."""
    start = e["offset"]
    if start < PLAIN:
        return None
    # local file header is 30 bytes + name + extra; find it after the prefix
    lh = start - PLAIN
    sig = bytes(b ^ k for b in b"PK\x03\x04")
    if d[HDR + lh:HDR + lh + 4] != sig:
        idx = d.find(sig, HDR + lh, HDR + lh + 256)
        if idx < 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{e['name']}: local header not found at {start}")
        lh = idx - HDR
    hdr = bytes(b ^ k for b in d[HDR + lh:HDR + lh + 30])
    nlen, elen = struct.unpack_from("<HH", hdr, 26)
    ds = HDR + lh + 30 + nlen + elen
    raw = bytes(c ^ k for c in d[ds:ds + e["csize"]])
    if e["method"] == 0:
        return raw
    if e["method"] == 8:
        return zlib.decompress(raw, -15)
    raise ValueError(f"unsupported method {e['method']}")


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("cmd", choices=["list", "extract"])
    ap.add_argument("bundle")
    ap.add_argument("outdir", nargs="?")
    a = ap.parse_args()

    d, k, body = load_container(a.bundle)
    entries = zip_entries(d, k, body)
    print(f"{os.path.basename(a.bundle)}: xor_key=0x{k:02x} "
          f"file={len(d)}B entries={len(entries)}")
    for e in entries:
        flag = " ENCRYPTED-PREFIX" if e["encrypted"] else ""
        print(f"  {e['name']:58s} method={e['method']} "
              f"csize={e['csize']:9d} usize={e['usize']:9d} "
              f"off={e['offset']:9d}{flag}")
    n_crc = n_bad = 0
    for e in entries:
        if e["encrypted"]:
            continue
        try:
            data = read_entry(d, k, e)
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"  ERROR {e['name']}: {exc}")
            n_bad += 1
            continue
        if zlib.crc32(data) & 0xFFFFFFFF != e["crc"]:
            print(f"  CRC-MISMATCH {e['name']}")
            n_bad += 1
        else:
            n_crc += 1
    print(f"  CRC32 verified entries: {n_crc} ok, {n_bad} bad "
          f"({sum(1 for e in entries if e['encrypted'])} skipped in encrypted prefix)")
    if a.cmd == "extract":
        assert a.outdir
        os.makedirs(a.outdir, exist_ok=True)
        for e in entries:
            name = e["name"]
            if not name or name.endswith("/"):
                print(f"  SKIP (directory): {name}")
                continue
            data = read_entry(d, k, e)
            if data is None:
                print(f"  SKIP (encrypted prefix): {name}")
                continue
            p = os.path.join(a.outdir, name.lstrip("/"))
            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
            open(p, "wb").write(data)
            print(f"  wrote {p} ({len(data)} bytes)")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

# Android AI/DNN reverse-engineering workspace

Single working directory for the APK AI survey and the per-APK reverse-engineering
reports. Generated 2026-10-24. All target APKs were analysed statically; no APK or
mounted image was modified.

## Scope

- Source image: `/run/media/asdf/30620d0d-1e41-4d55-af08-b4de2fb9c517/xiaomi poco f4 system/`
- 515 APKs scanned for on-device model assets, NN runtimes, and AI API markers.
- 53 candidate targets recorded in `targets.json`.
- 15 final targets in `scope.json`: intersection of the Xiaomi/POCO/partner rows
  with "ships an on-device model/runtime".
- Google-made apps were excluded (GmsCore, Velvet, Dialer, Messages, Photos,
  Drive, LatinIME, Turbo, Phonesky, AndroidSystemIntelligence,
  PrivateComputeServices, AdServices, OnDevicePersonalization, FederatedCompute,
  Maps, Chrome, WebView, Gmail, Meet, Assistant, Speech, TalkBack, SwitchAccess).

## Quick start

```bash
WS=/run/media/asdf/db69437b-ed35-414a-8bd1-bade16b06830/re_work
cd "$WS"

# Start here: per-app data-pipeline index and corrections
cat PIPELINES.md

# One report
cd reports/miui_securitycenter
cat report.md
cat PIPELINE.md
$HOME/re_workspace/venv312/bin/python reimpl/model.py models/assets_model
```

## Layout

| Path | Contents |
|---|---|
| `PIPELINES.md` | Index of all 15 apps, data-pipeline counts, reimplementation status, key corrections |
| `pipelines_index.json` | Machine-readable form of the same index |
| `PIPELINE_TEMPLATE.md` | Canonical 9-section data-pipeline contract used by every report |
| `PLAYBOOK.md` | Per-target reverse-engineering workflow and output rules |
| `SCHEMA.json` | Findings schema (`features`, `models`, `reimplementation`, `unknowns`) |
| `scope.json` | The 15 selected APKs (path, size, SHA-256) |
| `targets.json` | All 53 scanned candidates |
| `reports/<slug>/` | Per-APK deliverables (see below) |
| `tools/` | Shared analysis toolchain (`jadx`, APK/DEX, ELF, Ghidra, TFLite→JAX) |
| `tools/README.md` | Exact commands and limits for every tool |
| `samples/` | Small TFLite/ELF/DLC samples used to test the toolchain |
| `session_tmp/` | Session scratch that was moved off `/tmp`; see `MANIFEST.tsv` |
| `logs/` | Ghidra and long-running command logs |
| `shared/` | Shared notes and cross-report material |
| `work/` | Temporary tool test output |
| `*.s` at root | Ad-hoc disassembly fragments from cross-report investigations |

## Per-report contract

Every `reports/<slug>/` contains:

| Item | Description |
|---|---|
| `report.md` | Human analysis: identity, features, evidence, corrections, unknowns |
| `PIPELINE.md` | Data path: source/trigger → transport/format → preprocessing → model invocation → postprocessing → consumer → failure/fallback → confidence → reimplementation mapping |
| `findings.json` | Machine-readable features/models/unknowns plus `data_pipelines` |
| `sources/` | Targeted `jadx --single-class` output only (no full-APK decompilation) |
| `native/` | ELF facts, JNI signatures, disassembly, Ghidra pseudocode |
| `models/` | Extracted models/weights (size-capped) |
| `ir/` | Model IR: tensors, ops, shapes, weights tables |
| `reimpl/` | Runnable JAX reference implementation and `verify.txt` |
| `evidence/` | Command transcripts, hashes, xrefs, validators |

`PIPELINE.md` is the canonical data-flow contract. `findings.json.data_pipelines`
is the machine-readable companion; its key names vary slightly between reports
because each app exposes different data types.

## Targets and status

| slug | app | AI subsystem | reimplementation |
|---|---|---|---|
| `miui_securitycenter` | MIUI Security | SMS spam/phishing cascade; new TFLite engine; delegated AI subtitles/UltraClear | verified |
| `miui_securitycoreadd` | Security Core Add | AI auto-brightness inference + on-device training | verified |
| `miui_mediaeditor` | Mi Media Editor | Face/body beauty, scene recognition, makeup, inpaint | verified |
| `miui_extraphoto` | ExtraPhoto | Document scan, relighting, dual-camera bokeh | runs_unverified |
| `miui_biometric` | Biometric face unlock | Enroll/auth, liveness, embedding, template match | architecture_only |
| `miui_paymentservice` | Payment Service | Card digit OCR (HOG + LIBSVM) | verified |
| `miui_remote` | Mi Remote | Voice capture → VAD → cloud ASR/NLU → IR/TTS | runs_unverified |
| `qcom_voiceactivation` | Qualcomm Voice Activation | Always-on keyword detection and enrollment (OneVoice) | architecture_only |
| `mtb_modemtestbox` | Modem Test Box | Radio-metric weak-signal forecast (TFLite) | verified |
| `snapchat` | Snapchat | Haar/ERT/ORB lens CV; ML Kit; deferred `.dnn.enc` | verified |
| `tiktok_musically` | TikTok (musically) | Face detect/landmark/age → video effects | architecture_only |
| `tiktok_trill` | TikTok (trill) | Face detect/landmark/age → video effects | architecture_only |
| `kwai_video` | Kwai | Camera → YCNN face/beauty → encode | architecture_only |
| `kwai_bulldog` | Kwai Bulldog | Camera → YCNN face/beauty → encode | architecture_only |
| `kwai_live` | Kwai Live | Live camera+audio → effects → push | runs_unverified |

Status meanings:

- `verified` — numerical check against a vendor/TFLite reference or a bit-exact
  stage check.
- `runs_unverified` — runs on synthetic input, but no vendor runtime reference
  was available for numeric comparison.
- `architecture_only` — exact tensor/IO contract and architecture recovered,
  but weights are encrypted, downloaded, or otherwise unavailable, so the JAX
  code uses deterministic random initialisation.

## Running the reimplementations

Python 3.12 with JAX, LiteRT, flatbuffers, capstone, pyelftools, androguard and
LIEF lives in `$HOME/re_workspace/venv312`.

```bash
PY=$HOME/re_workspace/venv312/bin/python
cd reports/<slug>
$PY reimpl/verify.py        # most reports
$PY reimpl/pipeline.py      # some reports
$PY reimpl/model.py --demo  # container/architecture demos
```

Each `reimpl/README.md` and `reimpl/verify.txt` gives the exact command and the
observed result. The TFLite converter is `tools/tflite2jax.py`; it generated
standalone `model.py` + `params.npz` for the models that could be numerically
verified.

## Toolchain

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `tools/apk_inventory.py` | Package/manifest and zip inventory; AI asset/lib flags |
| `tools/dex_find.py` | DEX class/method search without decompilation |
| `tools/decompile_classes.py` | Targeted `jadx --single-class` with timeouts |
| `tools/strings_dex.py` | DEX string-table search |
| `tools/elf_info.py` | ELF/JNI/strings facts for aarch64 `.so` |
| `tools/disasm_elf.py` | Capstone disassembly, PLT/GOT annotations |
| `tools/ghidra_decompile.sh` | Headless Ghidra 12.1.2 wrapper with timeout/heap cap |
| `tools/carve_models.py` | Carve TFLite/ZIP-DLC/Caffe/model blobs |
| `tools/tflite_ir.py` | TFLite flatbuffer → JSON IR |
| `tools/tflite2jax.py` | TFLite → standalone JAX model with real weights |
| `tools/verify_tflite_jax.py` | JAX vs LiteRT numerical verification |
| `tools/jadx/bin/jadx` | Local JADX 1.5.6 |
| `/opt/ghidra/support/analyzeHeadless` | System Ghidra |

See `tools/README.md` for commands, supported ops, and limits.

## Session data

Session scratch that used to live in `/tmp` was moved to `session_tmp/` to make
it persistent. `session_tmp/MANIFEST.tsv` records original path, new path, type,
size and mtime. Absolute `/tmp/...` references in this workspace were rewritten
to the new paths.

Active harness state (`/tmp/omp-shell-snapshots-1000`) and unrelated `/tmp`
content (other projects, browser profiles, emulator logs, the `vmlinux-to-elf`
venv) were left in place.

Harness transcripts are outside this workspace:
`~/.omp/agent/sessions/-Downloads/*.jsonl` (current session:
`2026-10-24T01-11-42-367Z_01a16b76-ae1f-7781-be28-2d1c2eb6ad21.jsonl`).

## Known limits

- Static analysis only. No target app was executed on a device; the only
  runtime checks are JAX/LiteRT comparisons on synthetic inputs.
- Encrypted or absent weights remain the main blocker: Biometric STEF/Caffe
  payloads, TikTok smash-face descriptor, Qualcomm `eai2` layer tables, Kwai
  downloaded YCNN models, MediaEditor's missing bundle key.
- Cloud-side models (Xiaomi speech/SMS resource packs, Google Play services,
  Snapchat AI Factory `.dnn.enc`) are documented as boundaries, not reversed.
- Some apps delegate inference outside the APK (MIUI Security AI subtitles,
  UltraClear, beauty/privacy; Snapchat ML Kit); the reports state the boundary
  rather than claiming local weights.
- `findings.json.data_pipelines` is heterogeneous by design; use `PIPELINE.md`
  for a uniform contract.

## Provenance

- Scanned 515 APKs; 214 had AI-ish filenames, 217 had DEX AI markers.
- All reports use the same evidence rules: `confirmed`, `inferred`, `unknown`.
- Target hashes and paths are in `scope.json`; tool and model hashes are in each
  report's `evidence/hashes*`.
